englishSummary.headline: Co-management enrollment requirements and troubleshooting details updated
englishSummary.summary: The documentation now states that device-token auto-enrollment requires Windows 10 version 1803 or later and falls back to the user token if the device token fails. It also adds guidance to check ComanagementHandler.log and refreshes dashboard descriptions and image text.
englishSummary.adminImpact: When troubleshooting pending or failed enrollment, verify the Windows version and use ComanagementHandler.log for diagnostics. No mandatory administrator action is stated.
